## Headline

**Marketing-sourced pipeline hit $6.28M in Q3, up 18.6% vs Q2**, while blended CPL dropped 8.4% to $184. The team got more leads at lower cost, and a higher share of them converted. CAC payback moved inside 12 months for the first time.

## What moved

Blended CPL fell from $201 in W27 to $184 by W37 — a sustained 13-week downward trend, not a single-channel blip. **MQL→SQL conversion lifted 3.4 points to 32.1%**, which is the lever that explains why sourced pipeline grew faster than spend.

Channel-level: **Paid Search led ROI at 3.6x** with $2.18M sourced ACV on $425K spend. Webinars came in second on ROI (3.0x) with the lowest CPL of any channel at $134 — quietly the most efficient program we ran. Paid Social underperformed expectations ($680K sourced ACV on $280K spend, ROI 2.4x), driven by the Orion launch campaign that landed soft.

## So what

The Q3 result validates the **channel mix shift toward Paid Search + Webinars** we started in Q2. Recommend reallocating ~$50K from Paid Social to Webinars for Q4 — same audience, lower CPL, better intent signal. **CAC payback at 11.4 months** is below the 12-month threshold the Board cares about; the next milestone is sub-9 months, which gets us into the funding-friendly zone.

## Talking points

- **CPL improvement is sustained, not seasonal** — 8.4% over 13 weeks with the trend still pointing down. Continue current channel mix into Q4
- **Webinars are the unsung hero** of Q3: lowest CPL ($134), second-best ROI (3.0x), Enterprise-skew on attendees. Worth more budget
- **MQL→SQL conversion lift (32.1%, up 3.4pts) is the real story** — better-quality leads, not just more leads. Credit to the new lead-scoring rubric that shipped in W30
- **Mid-Market ABM campaign (CMP-Q3-014)** sourced $720K on $84K spend, the single-best campaign of the quarter. Pattern is replicable for EMEA
- **CAC payback inside 12 months** is a board-level milestone — flag it in the QBR

## Risks + caveats

The Paid Social underperformance is a real signal, not noise — we should review the Orion launch retro before doubling down on the next launch. Webinar capacity is the constraint on scaling that channel (we ran 8 in Q3, presenters maxed at 3-4 per quarter); if we want to lean in for Q4, we need either more guest speakers or a recorded-evergreen variant. Attribution model still credits last-touch — top-of-funnel content is probably under-credited; worth revisiting the model in Q1 once the next CRM upgrade lands.
